title: SEC7: discovery.rs — poisoned store lock returns silently
description: Lines 315–327 in run_discovery_round(): when the store lock is poisoned, the code logs at ERROR and returns early. However, no recovery message is sent. This means: (1) operators see ERROR but no 'shutdown' signal, (2) discovery task continues looping but does not re-attempt the poisoned store, (3) no indication that discovery has stopped working. Should emit a WARN/ERROR message or use a different control flow (e.g., skip iteration count update) to signal that discovery died. Impacts operator observability.
